title: Bike Fire ~9.1 mi southeast of us
text:
🔥 Bike Fire — about 172 acres, ~9.1 mi southeast of Tesoro Highlands (straight-line — farther by road).
Not close, and no evacuation activity for our area — sharing for awareness only.
Live map & status: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
